messages:
linh: quick readiness ping — trying to onboard 'sable-70b' into staging. weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/sable-70b/weights.tar.lz4. model_card lists max_seq_len=131072 and tokenizer adds 2 special system tokens by default. can infra/runtime folks confirm KV format compatibility and give a rough OOM/memory risk estimate for a 4xA100-80GB dedicated pool?

ashok: @linh I can check weights size and ACLs. plz give me the exact s3 prefix (no trailing /).

linh: s3://redwood-models/sable-70b (prefix contains weights.tar.lz4, tokenizer.json, config.yaml)

infra-bot: s3 object scan: 
- s3://redwood-models/sable-70b/weights.tar.lz4 — 378.2 GB
- s3://redwood-models/sable-70b/tokenizer.json — 2.1 MB
- s3://redwood-models/sable-70b/config.yaml — 5.2 KB
Access: public-read (should be fine for staging), checksum OK.

sarah: re: KV format — runtime currently supports kv-schema v2 and v4. if the model emits the older kv-flat layout we'll need a small conversion step. can you dump a couple of early-layer kv blobs (first 256 tokens) so I can sanity-check layout?

jess: tokenizer note — this tokenizer uses a conversational pretokenization that prefixes two control tokens for every chat turn. effectively sequence length increases by +2 per turn; for a single prompt that means +2, but for multi-turn streaming you can see extra 1–3 tokens. watchdoging for max_seq_len is important.

linh: good catch. config.yaml shows "add_special_tokens: true" and "chat_prefix_tokens: 2". also found max_position_embeddings: 131072. i attached a small sample: 
```
> head -n 40 tokenizer.json
{ "vocab_size": 50288, "special_tokens": {"bos": "", "eot": ""}, "chat_prefix_tokens": 2 }
```

ashok: weight unpack and local mount tested on staging host: tar extracts to ~402GB on disk (after lz4). Important: if we use eager KV caching and full weights mapped into memory, runtime can cross 320GB vram+host working set for a single replica. With 4x80GB we have 320GB total VRAM; that means we will need host RAM backing and/or quantization.

kevin: suggestion: try Q4_0 or Q5_1 quant profile in the deploy PR. it reduced mem per-replica in our tests by ~28% for a 70B model. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1298 — includes canary config and fallback to gpt-medium variant if OOM.

linh: thanks. two specific asks: 1) sarah — can you confirm if runtime automatic kv-downconvert (v4->v2) is implemented or needs a microtool? 2) ashok — can you confirm staging cluster has 64GB host swap disabled (we want predictable OOM behavior for the test)?

sarah: runtime does NOT do automatic downconvert yet. i can add a lightweight converter (python script) that rewrites kv blocks to v2 layout — should be ~1–2 hours plus tests. will open a small PR and attach the script to the onboarding checklist.

ashok: staging kernel settings: swap is off on all nodes in the dedicated staging pool. i verified cgroup memory limits are set by the deploy script.

jess: small QA on seqlen: when we run long-context smoke, use this prompt pattern to exercise edgecases: 1) long user prompt ~64k tokens, 2) system preamble (~4k), 3) 3-turn chat history each with ~8k. this will push kv cache into fragmented allocations.

linh: timeline plan: if sarah can make a converter today and kevin's PR gets the q4 config, i'd like to kick a 1-rep canary in staging tomorrow. target: exercise 80% token-generation throughput for 30m without OOM. who can own the canary run?

kevin: I can run the canary and monitor. i'll wire up alerts for memory headroom and automatic rollback. will post logs to the PR.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: attempted canary schedule blocked — missing deploy token in secrets manager (secrets: staging/deploy-token).

ashok: added staging/deploy-token to vault and rotated keys. canary should be schedulable now.

linh: perfect. final checklist for onboarding ticket: 
- weights path and ACLs confirmed (ashok) ✅
- tokenizer special tokens noted (jess) ✅
- kv format converter PR (sarah) WIP
- quantization config in PR (kevin) WIP
- canary run scheduled + monitor (kevin) TODO
- post-run memory/profile artifacts attached to PR (kevin) TODO

linh: pinging @all for any blockers. otherwise i will proceed with canary tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

sarah: will open converter PR in ~90m and link here.

kevin: will rebase PR and start canary at 09:30 PST tomorrow. will post results here.

jess: will run tokenizer fuzz tests against the sample and share tokenization edgecases in the PR.

linh: thanks everyone — closing the async loop. if anything comes up drop a message here and i'll pause the canary. :rocket:
